name: Great Bear Exploration Ltd
summary: Great Bear Exploration Ltd. engages in the acquisition, exploration and development of oil and gas prospects. Its portfolio includes Newkirk, Capitol, and Hydrocarbon Dynamics projects. It operates through the Exploration and Chemical segments. The Chemical segment includes clean oil technology and business worldwide. The Exploration segment covers the exploration, development, and production of oil and gas projects in the United States. The company was founded by Justin Pettett and Ryan Messer in October 2005 and is headquartered in Melbourne, Australia.
